scope: Mobile first, light theme, WeChat-inspired generated target; no claim of parity with an observed WeChat version.

fixture.policy: Synthetic fixture only. No real account or tokens in artifacts.

tokens.note: Authoring targets, not measured facts about a specific WeChat version.

screen_rules.navigation: Four root tabs; independent retained state; pushed routes hide bottom tabs; back closes modal/input before popping route.
screen_rules.composer: Native TextInput; IME composition never triggers premature send; keyboard/emoji/tray mutually exclusive; preserve drafts per room.
screen_rules.bubbles: Sender-based left/right alignment; max width about 72% of available content; text selectable/wrapped; group sender label and reply preview.
screen_rules.security: Keep Matrix E2EE, verification, recovery, receipt preference, room permissions and existing confirmations.
screen_rules.unavailable: Mocks may depict unavailable features but must not emit success or count toward backend acceptance.

screens.title: Chats
screens.visible: Room list with pinned section, unread/mention badges, muted state, avatar, sender preview and timestamp
screens.interactions: Open Alice, search, plus menu, long press, switch tabs
screens.return_behavior: Retain list anchor; clear selection only, keep unread semantics

screens.title: Search results
screens.visible: Focused query Alice; clear and Cancel; contact and chat sections
screens.return_behavior: Cancel restores prior scroll; stale query results ignored

screens.title: Conversation
screens.visible: Title/back/info; incoming white and outgoing green bubbles; time separators; draft composer
screens.interactions: Send, paginate, long press, avatar tap, info, back
screens.return_behavior: Retain draft and scroll; bottom tabs hidden; new incoming messages do not jump older reading position

screens.title: Keyboard and draft
screens.visible: Multiline draft above keyboard; Send enabled iff valid content; safe-area handling
screens.interactions: Type, Send, newline, hide keyboard, rotate
screens.return_behavior: Back closes input panel first; return preserves draft; no overlap

screens.title: Attachment tray
screens.visible: Two rows of native action cells; enabled capabilities distinguished
screens.interactions: Photo, file, location; close tray; return to keyboard
screens.return_behavior: Only one of keyboard, emoji or attachment panel visible

screens.title: Chat Info
screens.visible: Member tiles, search history, mute, sticky, clear, leave action
screens.interactions: Inspect members; toggle pinned/mute; destructive actions confirm
screens.return_behavior: Close returns same conversation anchor and draft

screens.title: Contacts
screens.visible: New Friends/Groups/Tags; alpha sections and index rail; avatars
screens.interactions: Search, alphabet drag, open contact, add friend
screens.return_behavior: Switch tab retains contacts position; index must hit section accurately

screens.title: Contact profile

screens.return_behavior: First DM confirmation; failed creation stays on profile; existing DM reused

screens.title: Discover

screens.title: Moments feed

screens.title: Me
